fact_rationales.F10: Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots is consistent with polyradiculopathy, a feature of BPDCN
fact_rationales.F14: A high white blood cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid is consistent with lymphomatous meningitis, but can also be seen in other conditions, including BPDCN
fact_rationales.F16: The presence of 98% atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid is highly suggestive of a lymphoid neoplasm, such as BPDCN or lymphomatous meningitis
fact_rationales.F7: Leukemia cutis is a specific type of skin lesion associated with BPDCN

ranked_facts.concept_key: cerebrospinal fluid analysis with atypical cells/blasts

ranked_facts.concept_key: elevated white blood cell count in cerebrospinal fluid
